triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER verified_pairs_only BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.match_results FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION site_private.guard_verified_pair()
CREATE TRIGGER verified_notifications_only BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.notification_outbox FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION site_private.guard_verified_notification()
CREATE TRIGGER fill_property_type_before_write BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.properties FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION site_private.fill_property_type()
CREATE TRIGGER fill_investor_criteria_before_write BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.investors FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION site_private.fill_investor_criteria()
CREATE TRIGGER sync_match_review_tasks_after_write AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.match_results FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION site_private.sync_match_review_tasks()

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION site_private.fill_property_type()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if new.property_type is null or btrim(new.property_type)='' then
 new.property_type:=site_private.title_property_type(new.title);
 end if;
 return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION site_private.fill_investor_criteria()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare c jsonb; n jsonb; mapped jsonb;
begin
 c:=site_private.safe_json(new.criteria_json); n:=site_private.safe_json(new.notes);
 if coalesce(jsonb_array_length(c->'property_types'),0)=0 and jsonb_typeof(n->'property_types')='array'
 and coalesce(n->>'interest_status','') in ('publicly_declared_acquisition','publicly_declared_direct_acquisition','javno_objavljena_potražnja') then
 select jsonb_agg(distinct typ) into mapped from (
 select case
 when v in ('stanovi') then 'Stan'
 when v in ('kuće') then 'Kuća'
 when v in ('poslovni prostori') then 'Poslovni prostor'
 when v in ('zgrade','cijele zgrade','zgrade s najmoprimcima','industrijske zgrade','stambene zgrade','cijele stare zgrade') then 'Zgrada'
 when v ~ '^(građevinsk[oai] zemljišt|urbano građevinsko zemljište|industrijsk[ao] zemljišt|logistička zemljišta|zemljišta za novogradnju|velike zemljišne parcele)' then 'Zemljište'
 else null end typ from jsonb_array_elements_text(n->'property_types') v
 ) t where typ is not null;
 if mapped is not null then
 c:=c||jsonb_build_object('property_types',mapped,'original_property_types',n->'property_types',
 'source_url',coalesce(c->>'source_url',n->>'official_url'),
 'checked_at',coalesce(c->>'checked_at',n->>'checked_at'),
 'preferred_locations',coalesce(c->'preferred_locations',n->'preferred_locations','[]'::jsonb),
 'required_criteria',jsonb_build_array('Provjeriti sve izvorne uvjete kupca i namjenu prije potvrde'),
 'imported_from_notes',true);
 new.criteria_json:=c::text;
 end if;
 end if;
 return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION site_private.safe_json(v text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin return v::jsonb; exception when others then return '{}'::jsonb; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION site_private.safe_stamp(v text)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if v ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' then return (v::date+1)::timestamp at time zone 'UTC'; end if;
 if v !~ '(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$' then return null; end if;
 return v::timestamptz;
exception when others then return null; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION site_private.title_property_type(v text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
select case
when v ~* '^(Apartment|Flat|Studio|Penthouse) for sale\M' or v ~* '^en vente (Appartement|Penthouse|Studio)\M'
 or v ~* '^[0-9]+ Bedroom (Apartment|Penthouse|Flat) For Sale\M'
 or v ~* '(^|[^[:alpha:]])(appartement|nieuwbouwappartement|wohnung|eigentumswohnung)([^[:alpha:]]|$)'
 or v ~* '^(Stan|Prizemni stan|Četverosobni stan|Derutni jednosobni stan)\M' then 'Stan'
when v ~* '^(House|Villa|Town-house) for sale\M' or v ~* '^en vente (Maison|Villa)\M'
 or v ~* '^[0-9]+ Bedroom (Terraced House|Detached House|House|Villa) For Sale\M'
 or v ~* '^(Samostalna kuća|Dvoetažna kuća|Stara prizemna stambena kuća)\M' then 'Kuća'
when v ~* '^(Mixed-use building|Apartment block) for sale\M' then 'Zgrada'
when v ~* '^(Land|Building land) for sale\M' or v ~* '^(Terreno en venta|Terreno in vendita|Stavebný pozemok)\M' or v ~* '^en vente Terrain\M'
 or v ~* '^(Građevinsko zemljište|Gradevinsko zemljiste|Urbanizirano gradevinsko zemljiste|Neurbanizirano građevinsko zemljište|Urbano zemljište|Urbano građevinsko zemljište|Industrijsko-obrtničko građevinsko zemljište)\M' then 'Zemljište'
else null end $function$
